name: smwmusic-shovel-knight-shovel-of-hope-in-the-halls-of-the-usurper
title: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope - In the Halls of the Usurper
description:
This is the music from King Knight's stage in the Shovel Knight campaign. It has a castle vibe with some classical music inspirations.

This is ported straight from the original song and uses samples of the same pulse duty cycles to get as close to the source as possible. Shout-out to muscialman for the pulse duty, sawtooth, and NES triangle samples.

I did the best I could with the SNES noise options to replicate the drum parts. Enjoy :)
